quantity_oi_abs_change_at_least_5pct.basis: Adjacent displayed 10/13 11:00 and 10/13 12:00 hourly base-asset quantities, not USDT notional.

closed_1h_volume_and_price.basis: Completed displayed 2026/10/13 11:00 bar versus mean of six preceding completed 2026/10/13 05:00 through 2026/10/13 10:00 base volumes. Both conditions must hold.

reliable_mark_abs_change_at_least_10pct.basis: Same-symbol Binance mark field in adjacent actual UTC sampling windows; actual elapsed time disclosed with no rescaling.

alert_assessment.limitation: A threshold crossing is a research candidate only. A separate fresh same-contract read must confirm it before any alert; these files do not establish confirmation.

displayed_chart_sequence.sequence_basis: Fresh public chart sequence verified by capturing worker; chart timezone remains unknown.
displayed_chart_sequence.interpretation: Chart-local labels only; adjacency does not identify UTC event time.
